subject: MAP: eval kit boarding runway, acceptance & recall clauses
messages:
From: Erin Caldwell <erin@acmeretail.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, procurement@acmeretail.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff: exchange of eval kit + acceptance criteria

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at AcmeRetail is excited to run the eval. Procurement asked me to propose a mutual action plan so we can swap the testcases and associated prompt pack with clear acceptance gates and a short recall clause for the ephemeral artifacts.

High-level asks from our side:
- Target runway: 3 weeks of active testing (we'd like to sign off or request remediation within that window)
- Acceptance gates: pass-rates on a handful of seeded testcases, no PII leakage, and reproducible failure cases for regressions
- Usage constraints: Can Redwood confirm ephemeral use only, no dataset retention beyond the trial window, and no transfer to third parties?

Can your team share a draft MAP and a checklist we can feed to legal and procurement? Also copying procurement and Jason from Legal for visibility.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — we are aiming to start pilot runs by May 3.

Best,
Erin Caldwell
Head of Applied ML, AcmeRetail
Erin Caldwell | AcmeRetail

Attachments: none in initial note
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Erin Caldwell <erin@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, procurement@acmeretail.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff: exchange of eval kit + acceptance criteria

Erin — thanks for the context and timeline. Draft attached and a lightweight checklist that maps to our acceptance flow. Key points up front so procurement/legal can triage quickly: 

1) Runway & milestones (proposed):
   - Week 0: mutual action plan signed (DocuSign) + secure transfer of testcases and prompt pack to an ephemeral sandbox
   - Week 1: initial smoke tests (sanity + seeded-case pass rates)
   - Week 2: focused regression tests (customer-provided scenarios) and privacy verification
   - Week 3: acceptance window + remediation window

2) Usage & retention constraints (Redwood guarantees):
   - Ephemeral access only: artifacts removed from Redwood-hosted sandboxes 7 days after acceptance or 30 days after transfer if no acceptance decision is reached
   - No redistribution: datasets/prompt packs are single-use for evaluation; no third-party transfer without express written consent
   - Audit trail: we will provide exportable access logs and a signed attestation of deletion once artifacts are removed

3) Acceptance criteria (mapped in checklist):
   - Pass thresholds for seeded testcases (we put suggested pass thresholds in the checklist)
   - Privacy scan: automated PII scan with manual sampling
   - Failure reporting: reproducible transcript + model version + seed prompts for any failing case

I attached: MAP-draft-v1.pdf and Testcase-Acceptance-Checklist.xlsx. Ben has a short license snippet he wants to suggest for the redistribution/ephemeral clause — Ben, see inline request below.

If that aligns, I can push the DocuSign link and target signing by Friday so you can start the sandbox transfer the week of May 3.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Manager, Solutions — Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf, Testcase-Acceptance-Checklist.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Erin Caldwell <erin@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, procurement@acmeretail.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff: exchange of eval kit + acceptance criteria

Forwarding a proposed license snippet we use for short evaluation swaps — very narrow, bulletproof language to keep legal happy.

--- Forwarded message ---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: License-proposal-snippet.txt

License-proposal-snippet.txt (proposed language):
1) Purpose-limited grant: AcmeRetail is granted a non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable right to use the supplied evaluation materials solely to evaluate Redwood’s services during the MAP period.
2) Retention & deletion: Redwood will delete copies of the supplied materials from production and sandbox environments within 7 days of final acceptance or 30 days after transfer if no acceptance decision is reached. Redwood will provide a signed deletion attestation and supporting access logs.
3) No derivative distribution: AcmeRetail may not distribute, sublicense, or otherwise provide the evaluation materials to any third party without Redwood’s prior written consent.
4) Audit & verification: Redwood will permit AcmeRetail to verify deletion via hash-based proof and provide exportable access logs for the evaluation period.

Ben — happy to tighten wording. Marissa, flag anything operationally missing (transfer protocol, encryption at rest, egress controls).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Erin Caldwell <erin@acmeretail.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jason Lee <j.lee@acmeretail.com>, procurement@acmeretail.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 16:41:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff: exchange of eval kit + acceptance criteria

Thanks Mina and Ben — this is exactly the level of detail we need. Quick notes from Legal/Procurement after a first pass: 
- Retention window looks fine; Jason asked if we can shorten the post-transfer no-decision window to 21 days instead of 30 (he says it speeds up audit sign-off).
- We want the deletion attestation to include the object hashes for the primary files so our compliance team can cross-check.

If Redwood is ok with shortening to 21 days, procurement can sign this week. Otherwise we can accept 30 but it will add one more review cycle.

If everyone agrees, please push the final DocuSign link and we can sign by Thursday; target sandbox transfer the week of May 3.

—Erin
Erin Caldwell
Head of Applied ML, AcmeRetail
